50349-a-basket-of-barley-loaves.title: A Basket Of Barley Loaves
50349-a-basket-of-barley-loaves.creator: Unknown
50349-a-basket-of-barley-loaves.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The crowd was thronging and jostling. Eager and wistful faces were turned to One who stood in the midst. His countenance was mild and compassionate; and as I gazed upon him, a deep desire filled my heart to know and follow this Man of Sorrows. With swiftest steps I hurried on and pressed into the crowd.

5601-jan-of-the-windmill-a-story-of-the-.title: Jan Of The Windmill A Story Of The Plains
5601-jan-of-the-windmill-a-story-of-the-.creator: Unknown
5601-jan-of-the-windmill-a-story-of-the-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. THE CHEAP JACK.—“PITCHERS”. SCARECROWS AND MEN.—JAN REFUSES TO “MAKE 77 GEARGE.”—UNCANNY.—“JAN’S OFF.”—THE MOON AND THE CLOUDS. THE WHITE HORSE.—COMROGUES.—MOERDYK.—GEORGE CONFIDES IN THE 84 CHEAP JACK—WITH RESERVATION. GEORGE AS A MONEYED MAN.—SAL.—THE “WHITE HORSE.”—THE 91 WEDDING.—THE WINDMILLER’S WIFE FORGETS, AND REMEMBERS TOO LATE. SUBLUNARY ART.—JAN GOES TO SCHOOL.—DAME DATCHETT AT 98 HOME.—JAN’S FIRST SCHOOL SCRAPE.—JAN DEFENDS HIMSELF.

arxiv-1511-00632.title: Partial Functional Linear Quantile Regression for Neuroimaging Data Analysis Journal: Neurocomputing
arxiv-1511-00632.creator: Dengdeng Yu, Linglong Kong, Ivan Mizera, the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
arxiv-1511-00632.description: Abstract We propose a prediction procedure for the functional linear quantile regression model by using partial quantile covariance techniques and develop a simple partial quantile regression (SIMPQR) algorithm to efficiently extract partial quantile regression (PQR) basis for estimating functional coefficients. We further extend our partial quantile covariance techniques to functional composite quantile regression (CQR) defining partial composite quantile covariance.

arxiv-2106-08170.title: How Modular Should Neural Module Networks Be for Systematic Generalization?
arxiv-2106-08170.creator: Vanessa D’Amario, Tomotake Sasaki, Xavier Boix
arxiv-2106-08170.description: Abstract Neural Module Networks (NMNs) aim at Visual Question Answering (VQA) via composition of modules that tackle a sub-task. NMNs are a promising strategy to achieve systematic generalization, ie. overcoming biasing factors in the training distribution. However, the aspects of NMNs that facilitate systematic generalization are not fully understood.

arxiv-2306-02967.title: Synthesis of Distributed Protocols by Enumeration Modulo Isomorphisms
arxiv-2306-02967.creator: Derek Egolf (✉), Stavros Tripakis
arxiv-2306-02967.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Derek Egolf (✉), Stavros Tripakis. Synthesis of distributed protocols is a hard, often undecidable, problem. Completion techniques provide partial remedy by turning the problem into a search problem. However, the space of candidate completions is still massive. In this paper, we propose optimization techniques to reduce the size of the search space by a factorial factor by exploiting symmetries ( isomorphisms ) in functionally equivalent solutions.

arxiv-2405-08510.title: Growing Artificial Neural Networks for Control: the Role of Neuronal Diversity Conference: Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference; July 14–18, 2024; Melbourne, VIC, Australia Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference (GECCO ’24 Companion), July 14–18, 2024, Melbourne, VIC, Australia D
arxiv-2405-08510.creator: Eleni Nisioti 1 , Erwan Plantec 1 , Milton Montero, Joachim Winther Pedersen, Sebastian Risi
arxiv-2405-08510.description: Abstract . In biological evolution complex neural structures grow from a handful of cellular ingredients. As genomes in nature are bounded in size, this complexity is achieved by a growth process where cells communicate locally to decide whether to differentiate, proliferate and connect with other cells.

arxiv-2406-04306.title: Improving Uncertainty Estimation through Semantically Diverse Language Generation
arxiv-2406-04306.creator: Lukas Aichberger, Kajetan Schweighofer, Mykyta Ielanskyi, Sepp Hochreiter
arxiv-2406-04306.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) can suffer from hallucinations when generating text. These hallucinations impede various applications in society and industry by making LLMs untrustworthy. Current LLMs generate text in an autoregressive fashion by predicting and appending text tokens. When an LLM is uncertain about the semantic meaning of the next tokens to generate, it is likely to start hallucinating.

arxiv-2501-15580.title: Connection between memory performance and optical absorption in quantum reservoir computing
arxiv-2501-15580.creator: Niclas Götting, Steffen Wilksen, Alexander Steinhoff, Frederik Lohof, Christopher Gies
arxiv-2501-15580.description: Abstract The fading memory property is a key requirement for reservoir computers – a specific type of recurrent neural network with fixed internal weights. While mostly undesired in gate-based quantum computing, dissipation due to material imperfections or coupling to the environment acts as a natural mechanism intrinsically providing fading memory to reservoir computers based on dynamical open quantum systems.

arxiv-2505-23277.title: Sentinel: Decoding Context Utilization via Attention Probing for Efficient LLM Context Compression
arxiv-2505-23277.creator: Yong Zhang, Heng Li, Yanwen Huang, Ning Cheng, Yang Guo, Yun Zhu, Yanmeng Wang, Shaojun Wang, Jing Xiao
arxiv-2505-23277.description: Abstract Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) often suffers from long and noisy retrieved contexts. Existing context compression methods typically rely on heuristic relevance estimation or supervised compression models rather than on how LLMs utilize retrieved context during inference. We propose Sentinel, a lightweight sentence-level compression framework that decodes inference-time contextual utilization behaviors from head-wise attention patterns of frozen LLMs.

arxiv-2506-00949.title: Anomalous current fluctuations and mobility-driven clustering
arxiv-2506-00949.creator: Tanmoy Chakraborty, Punyabrata Pradhan
arxiv-2506-00949.description: Abstract We study steady-state current fluctuations in hardcore lattice gases on a ring of L L sites, where N N particles perform symmetric, extended-ranged hopping. The hop length is a random variable depending on a length scale l 0 l_{0} (hopping range) and the inter-particle gap.

arxiv-2508-12508.title: Segmenting Thalamic Nuclei: T 1 \mathrm{T_{1}} Maps Provide a Reliable and Efficient Solution
arxiv-2508-12508.creator: Anqi Feng, Zhangxing Bian, Samuel W. Remedios, Savannah P. Hays, Blake E. Dewey, Jiachen Zhuo, Dan Benjamini, Jerry L. Prince
arxiv-2508-12508.description: Abstract Accurate thalamic nuclei segmentation is crucial for understanding neurological diseases, brain functions, and guiding clinical interventions. However, the optimal inputs for segmentation remain unclear. This study systematically evaluates multiple MRI contrasts, including MPRAGE and FGATIR sequences, quantitative PD and T 1 \mathrm{T_{1}} maps, and multiple T1-weighted images at different inversion times (multi-TI), to determine the most effective inputs.

arxiv-2511-08404.title: Multistart Large Neighborhood Search for the liquefied natural gas transportation and trading over long-term time horizons
arxiv-2511-08404.creator: S. Iudin, M. Veshchezerova, K. Tsarova, G. Tadumadze, V. Shete, J.-K. Hao, M. Perelshtein
arxiv-2511-08404.description: Abstract Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) transportation is a critical component of the energy industry. It enables the efficient and large-scale movement of natural gas across vast distances by converting it into a liquid form, thereby addressing global demand and connecting suppliers with consumers.

arxiv-2602-00094.title: Trade-offs Between Individual and Group Fairness in Machine Learning: A Comprehensive Review
arxiv-2602-00094.creator: Sandra Benítez-Peña, Blas Kolic, Victoria Menendez, Belén Pulido

pmc-10735129.title: Factors influencing the supportive care needs of female patients with genital cancer in South Korea
pmc-10735129.creator: Yu-Jung Son, Keum-Hee Nam, JaeLan Shim
pmc-10735129.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Genital cancers are particularly important compared to other cancers because of the psychological impact they have on the individual. This study investigated the complexity in illness and quality of life among female genital cancer patients and determined the effects of these factors on supportive care needs to provide evidential data for the development of nursing intervention strategies to reduce supportive care needs in female genital cancer patients. This cross-sectional study collected data from July 22 to August 17, 2021.

pmc-10757169.title: A Pilot Feasibility Trial of an Upper Extremity Assistive System
pmc-10757169.creator: Emma Hammelef, Saami J Zakaria, Sarah H Andersen, Thomas J Kelly, Namrata Grampurohit, Mikael Avery, Alessandro Napoli, Mary Jane Mulcahey, Mijail Demian Serruya
pmc-10757169.description: ObjectiveTo develop and clinically evaluate a customizable active upper extremity (UE) assistive system with integrated functional electrical stimulation (FES) that improves function and independence of individuals during activities of daily living (ADLs).DesignSingle-arm, prospective, open-label cohort feasibility trial.SettingAn academic research institution.ParticipantsSubjects were 5 adults with a medical history of stroke resulting in distal UE impairment (N=5).

pmc-11538006.title: Headache disorders: a persistent public health challenge for the under 50s
pmc-11538006.creator: Weijian Meng, Liutao Sui
pmc-11538006.description: IntroductionCurrently, neurological diseases has surpassed cardiovascular diseases as the primary cause of global disease burden. Among these, headache disorders are the most prevalent and have emerged as the main cause of disability in people under 50 years old in recent years.

pmc-12734010.title: Performance-Enhancing Effects of Inhaled Medications: Implications for Heart, Muscle Function, and Doping Detection in Athletes
pmc-12734010.creator: Riccardo Cricco, Andrea Segreti, Emanuele Stirpe, Aurora Ferro, Martina Ciancio, Flavia Cipriani, Chiara Fossati, Gian Paolo Ussia, Fabio Pigozzi, Francesco Grigioni, Pasqualina Buono
pmc-12734010.description: Inhaled medications, commonly prescribed for respiratory conditions such as asthma and exercise-induced bronchoconstriction, are increasingly scrutinized in sports medicine due to their potential performance-enhancing effects. Bronchodilators, in particular, may improve lung function, increase oxygen delivery, and influence muscle contractility, potentially enhancing athletic performance.

pmc-12745151.title: Avapritinib in the treatment of systemic mastocytosis with associated acute myeloid leukemia after poor graft function following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation: a case study and review of the literature
pmc-12745151.creator: Ruihua Mi, Xiang Li, Lin Chen, Lin Wang, Yixuan Ma, Yuewen Fu, Xudong Wei
pmc-12745151.description: IntroductionThis case is reported due to its novelty in demonstrating the efficacy of avapritinib, a selective KIT inhibitor, in a rare systemic mastocytosis-associated acute myeloid leukemia (SM-AML) patient with non-D816V KIT mutations and RUNX1::RUNX1T1 fusion. Avapritinib is established for KIT D816V-mutant advanced systemic mastocytosis (AdvSM).

pmc-13070414.title: Iridoids from Traditional Chinese Medicine for Neuropathic Pain: Therapeutic Potential and Molecular Mechanisms
pmc-13070414.creator: Wenjun Wang, Tianlong Liu, Yi Ding, Xiaolong Liu, Ren Qingji, Yi Zhang, Zhengxiang Zhang
pmc-13070414.description: Neuropathic pain (NP) affects global public health problem and remains inadequately controlled by existing drugs. A class of plant-derived iridoids, predominantly glycosides found in traditional Chinese medicine like Lamiophlomis rotata (Benth). Kudo, have recently emerged as promising neuroprotective substances. Here we systematically review pre-clinical efficacy and mechanisms of iridoids across various rodent models of NP.

pmc-13109299.title: Structural parameter determination and pruning pattern analysis of pear tree shoots for dormant pruning
pmc-13109299.creator: Jiaqi Li, Hao Sun, Gengchen Wu, Hu Xu, Shutian Tao, Wei Guo, Kaijie Qi, Hao Yin, Shaoling Zhang, Seishi Ninomiya, Yue Mu
pmc-13109299.description: The comprehensive understanding of the dormant pruning patterns in pear trees, along with the accurate identification of shoots suitable for pruning, is essential for implementing automated pruning and fruit production. Due to the complexity of tree architecture, previous descriptions of pruning strategies were qualitative summaries based on experience.

pmc-13420204.title: Machine Learning Model for Predicting Suicide Risks Among Patients With Posttraumatic Stress Disorder Who Received Opioids
pmc-13420204.creator: Shu Huang, Amie J. Goodin, Jill A. Star, Serena Jingchuan Guo, Jiang Bian, Jie Xu, Tianze Jiao

pmc-13424983.title: Development and preliminary validation of an entrustable professional activities framework for undergraduate midwifery education
pmc-13424983.creator: Yu Liu, Xuebing Zheng, Shaohua Chen, Binbin Lin, Lei Fan, Yunfeng Jiang, Xiaoyan Wang, Qin Xu, Guiru Xu, Pingping Qiu, Xiaoyun Lin, Yan Fang, Jihong Song
pmc-13424983.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to develop and preliminary validate an entrustable professional activities (EPAs) framework for undergraduate midwifery students in China, providing a reference for undergraduate midwifery education and competency assessment.MethodsAn initial EPA framework was constructed through a systematic literature review, qualitative research, and participant observation.

pmc-13542984.title: Enrollment in a General Nutrition Course Is Associated With Higher Nutrition Knowledge Scores Among University Students
pmc-13542984.creator: Hadia Radwan, Hayder Hasan, Dana N Abdelrahim, Falak Zeb, MoezAlIslam E Faris, Tareq Osaili, Mona Hashim, Leila Cheikh Ismail, Reyad Shaker Obaid, Salma Abu‐Qiyas, Dimitrios Papandreou, Nadia Alkalbani, Farah Naja
pmc-13542984.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and MethodsThis study examined the association between completion of a general nutrition course (GNC) and nutrition knowledge among university students in the United Arab Emirates (UAE). A cross‐sectional online survey was conducted at the University of Sharjah. Nutrition knowledge was compared between students who completed the GNC (GNC group, n = 249) and those who did not (non‐GNC group, n = 561). The elective course comprised three modules covering macronutrients and micronutrients, selected nutrition topics, and common nutrition‐related diseases.
